[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 16:45  
[PREFERENCE] User is trying to plan healthy snacks for the week.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers almonds as a snack for the trail mix.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trail mix is a healthy snack option, and almonds are an excellent choice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Basic Almond Trail Mix Recipe:  
- Ingredients: 2 cups of almonds, 1 cup of mixed nuts, 1 cup of dried fruit, 1/2 cup of seeds, 1/2 cup of dark chocolate chips, pinch of salt.  
- Optional ingredients: 1/2 cup of puffed rice or wheat cereal, 1/4 cup of shredded coconut, 1/4 cup of cinnamon or cocoa powder.  
- Instructions: Combine ingredients, mix well, and store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for customizing the trail mix include adjusting proportions, using different types of nuts, and adding spices.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to make the trail mix more savory.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for savory spices and herbs include smoky paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, dried herbs, cumin, and coriander.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other savory ingredients include soy nuts, pretzels, sesame sticks, and dried seaweed.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering adding grated Parmesan cheese to the trail mix.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Grated Parmesan cheese can add a savory flavor and umami kick.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for adding Parmesan cheese: use high-quality cheese, grate it fresh, start with a small amount, and mix it well.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of making energy balls to go along with the trail mix.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Simple No-Bake Energy Balls Recipe:  
- Ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats, 1 cup creamy peanut butter, 1/2 cup honey, 1/4 cup chocolate chips, pinch of salt.  
- Optional ingredients: chopped nuts, shredded coconut, dried cranberries.  
- Instructions: Combine ingredients, shape into balls, refrigerate for 30 minutes, and store in an airtight container for up to 5 days.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for freezing energy balls include placing them on a baking sheet, freezing until solid, transferring to an airtight container, and labeling with the date.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to make a double batch of energy balls and store them in an airtight container for up to 5 days.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Thawing methods for frozen energy balls include room temperature, refrigerator, or microwave.
